memory.reason: Separate routed circuits. Candidate retains on-chip input embedding and stages 512 bytes per eight-row group from a 20 KiB DMA mapping.

memory_bandwidth.reason: Eight bytes per accepted beat at HP0. DDR controller traffic was unavailable.

power_validation.reason: Module sensor was used without independent calibration.

prefill.reason: No separate prefill timer. TTFT and internal counters are available.

serving_load.reason: Outside the fixed one-board circuit comparison.

correctness.evidence: Exact reference outputs and validated FPGA counters on 200 timed replies, 36 warm-ups and 9 smoke replies. All 320 original BOS scores verified.

limitations: One board and boot, three fixed prompts and an ABBA experiment with two logical pairs.
Gross VCC_SOM measurements include request gaps and verification. Independent calibration and off-module power were unavailable.
AXI interface bytes count accepted beats. DDR controller traffic was unavailable.
Only the candidate exposes the DDR counters. Its between-request counter checks are included in gross workload energy.
The separately routed candidate exposes storage savings and the added DDR interface and buffering.
Kernel taint from the temporary unsigned out-of-tree module persists until reboot.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Board CPU admission through useful byte and completion observations. Gross VCC_SOM block integral includes request gaps and verification.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact outputs, stop reasons and contexts. Verified AXI and FPGA cycle accounting.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Three mixed warm-ups or one single-prompt warm-up per ordered arm.

quality.evidence: Frozen W16A16 arithmetic, weights, workload and stopping rules.
